verdict: Google Business Profile engagement is falling sharply across all three locations.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all lead-generating activity across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision has run exclusively through organic channels — Google Business Profile and search — with zero paid spend on any platform. Over the past 7 days, GBP engagement dropped 55% at Forte Metals, 60% at Advance Grinding, and 71% at O'Hare Precision, with each location recording zero profile actions over the final three days of the period; this is a confirmed trend, not a data blip. The drop coincides with a pullback in search visibility, and with no paid campaigns active to provide a floor, there is currently no compensating source of inbound activity. We are investigating the root cause of the organic visibility decline and moving to resolve the outstanding setup work — including site reindexing and contact list completion — that will unlock outreach and paid activation in the weeks ahead.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell to zero across all three locations in the final days of this period, while paid channels remain inactive — leaving no current source of inbound leads.
watch_item.fix: The web and SEO root-cause review is underway, site reindexing is queued, and contact list completion is in progress to enable outreach sequences and paid channel activation.
